title: Improve Privacy & Cookies notice on small screens
body: The Confirm button overlaps informational text on certain mobile devices. I'm unable to reproduce this on an iPhone XR, or using the mobile emulators in Chrome. We need to figure out which device/browser combo this is and reproduce the issue, then fix.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
